meta.about: The case lens's fourth held-out lines (lens-unknown-forms, 2026-11-01, seed 20261101): 140 content lines drawn at random, each holding a form the lens knew nothing of before this round (bun test/case-lens-gaps.ts on the branch's base), one form each; the 64 with a case in their line labelled by hand before any lens ran on them (the verbs, interjections, adverbs and numbers left out; the names' and the interjections' entries were written then, the other words' not yet), and run to measure (test/case-lens-eval.ts heldout4): how the new readings do on lines no rule was tuned on. Machine-labelled (Claude): wants a native speaker's check.

items.sl: Na veliko soboto nesemo žegen v cerkev.
items.en: On Holy Saturday we take the basket to church to be blessed.

items.sl: Dobro jutro, Jan! Brr, zjutraj je mraz. Lahko si grejem roke?
items.en: Good morning, Jan! Brr, it is cold in the morning. Can I warm my hands?

items.sl: Ograja je zelo trdna!
items.en: The railing is very firm!

items.sl: Na tleh najde kovanec.
items.en: She finds a coin on the floor.

items.sl: Muri, pridi sem! Pusti konja!
items.en: Muri, come here! Leave the horse alone!

items.sl: Pameten si. Vida pa je bila obupana mati, ki bi za sina storila vse.
items.en: You're wise. But Vida was a desperate mother who would have done anything for her son.

items.sl: Mislim, da ne. Čeprav je živela na dvoru, je pogrešala dom.
items.en: I don't think so. Although she lived at court, she missed home.

items.sl: Jurčke. Poglej, kakšen lepotec!
items.en: Porcini. Look, what a beauty!

items.sl: Po košnji je Tone spal kot polh.
items.en: After the mowing Tone slept like a log.

items.sl: Voda vrti mlinsko kolo.
items.en: The water turns the mill wheel.

items.sl: Mestna ura je točna.
items.en: The town clock is exact.

items.sl: O, hvala, Jan! Kdor hitro da, dvakrat da.
items.en: Oh, thank you, Jan! Who gives quickly gives twice.

items.sl: Pesek je rumen in mehak.
items.en: The sand is yellow and soft.

items.sl: Tako je. Pravijo, da še danes gleda čez morje. Lahko noč, sinko.
items.en: That's right. They say she still looks out over the sea today. Good night, son.

items.sl: O lepi Vidi? Tudi Prešeren je napisal pesem o njej, kajne?
items.en: About beautiful Vida? Prešeren wrote a poem about her too, didn't he?

items.sl: Vse so notri? Ena manjka … ne, tu je, Pikica.
items.en: Are they all in? One's missing … no, here she is, Pikica.

items.sl: Klobase in steklenica Markovega vina!
items.en: Sausages and a bottle of Marko's wine!

items.sl: Ha ha! Ovčke te imajo rade.
items.en: Ha ha! The sheep like you.

items.sl: Jaz pridem že ob devetih, z rožami. Kdaj prideš ti?
items.en: I'm coming at nine already, with the flowers. When are you coming?

items.sl: Krpan pride na Dunaj s svojo kobilo. Vsi se mu smejijo. Tako majhna kobila!
items.en: Krpan comes to Vienna with his mare. Everyone laughs at him. Such a small mare!

items.sl: Pred šestdesetimi leti sem igral za vas.
items.en: Sixty years ago I played for the village.

items.sl: Ej, poglej gor! Vrhovi so rdeči.
items.en: Hey, look up! The peaks are red.

items.sl: Mlinar France melje žito.
items.en: France the miller is grinding grain.

items.sl: Povej: komu proda Samol Jurija?
items.en: Tell me: who does Samol sell Jurij to?

items.sl: Peter je zelo šibek. Drugi pastirji se mu smejijo. Povej: kakšen je Peter?
items.en: Peter is very weak. The other shepherds laugh at him. Tell me: what is Peter like?

items.sl: Turki pridejo do Muljave. Ljudje bežijo v cerkev, za visoko obzidje.
items.en: The Turks come to Muljava. The people flee into the church, behind the high walls.

items.sl: Ja, to je Tržaški zaliv.
items.en: Yes, that is the Gulf of Trieste.

items.sl: Tako je! Dober kosec si.
items.en: That's right! You are a good mower.

items.sl: Ta je pa še večji!
items.en: This one is even bigger!

items.sl: Vlij jajčno zmes v ponev in jo peci na zmernem ognju.
items.en: Pour the egg mixture into the pan and cook it over a medium heat.

items.sl: Visoko v gorah, pod Triglavom, živi bel gams. Ime mu je Zlatorog.
items.en: High in the mountains, under Triglav, lives a white chamois. His name is Zlatorog.

items.sl: Ja, samo osem stopinj. Mrzlo bo.
items.en: Yes, only eight degrees. It will be cold.

items.sl: Pst, Jan. Megla. Moj oče je rekel: v megli pride iz vode povodni mož.
items.en: Shh, Jan. Fog. My father used to say: in the fog the water man comes out of the water.

items.sl: Babica Micka lepo poje.
items.en: Grandma Micka sings beautifully.

items.sl: Pod goro Peco.
items.en: Under Mount Peca.
items.note: no verb: where it is (the instrumental) or where to (the accusative)

items.sl: Ta deska je predolga.
items.en: This board is too long.

items.sl: Kladivo in žeblje. Tam, na delovni mizi.
items.en: The hammer and nails. There, on the workbench.

items.sl: Lepo, kajne? Jutri prinesem milnico še za otroke.
items.en: Lovely, isn't it? Tomorrow I'll bring soapy water for the children too.

items.sl: Jutro je tu. Srna in mladič gresta v gozd. Lovski blagor!
items.en: Morning is here. The doe and the fawn are going into the forest. Lovski blagor!

items.sl: Stanujem v Trnovem.
items.en: I live in Trnovo.

items.sl: Poglej, na globusu je Piran čisto blizu. Ena pika!
items.en: Look, on the globe Piran is really close. One dot!

items.sl: Po skoraj dvajsetih letih sta se spet našla!
items.en: After almost twenty years they found each other again!

items.sl: Ta plašč je prevelik zame.
items.en: This coat is too big for me.

items.sl: Večerna zarja pobarva gore.
items.en: The evening glow colours the mountains.

items.sl: Spomnim se. Rekli ste, da odpirajo pot do zaklada pod Bogatinom.
items.en: I remember. You said they open the way to the treasure under Bogatin.

items.sl: Seveda. Izvolite, tukaj je palčka.
items.en: Of course. Here you are, here's the wand.

items.sl: Dober večer, Jan. Nocoj ti povem zgodbo o Kekcu. Veš, kdo je Kekec?
items.en: Good evening, Jan. Tonight I'll tell you a story about Kekec. Do you know who Kekec is?

items.sl: Ha! Samo oči ima zunaj.
items.en: Ha! Only its eyes are out.

items.sl: Oho, ti si pa sladkosned!
items.en: Oho, you've got a sweet tooth!

items.sl: Za delo na praznik je Tone dobil dvojno plačilo.
items.en: For working on the holiday Tone got double pay.

items.sl: Ja, nekoč bom šel na Triglav!
items.en: Yes, some day I will go up Triglav!

items.sl: Na mizi je gos z mlinci.
items.en: There is goose with mlinci on the table.

items.sl: Klobase so že na žaru.
items.en: The sausages are already on the grill.

items.sl: Tiho … Plovec se premika. Riba je prijela!
items.en: Quiet … The float is moving. A fish has bitten!

items.sl: Tako je. In na mostu. Ko greš čez Zmajski most, pozdravi zmaje. Lahko noč.
items.en: That's right. And on the bridge. When you cross the Dragon Bridge, say hello to the dragons. Good night.

items.sl: Tako je. A skrivnost ni ostala dolgo skrita.
items.en: That's right. But the secret didn't stay hidden for long.

items.sl: Suha roba je iz Ribnice.
items.en: The wooden ware is from Ribnica.

items.sl: Prišel je pozno, kar je Vido razjezilo.
items.en: He came late, which made Vida angry.

items.sl: Nad Komno stoji Bogatin. Ime ima po bogastvu, ki ga skriva.
items.en: Above Komna stands Bogatin. It is named after the riches it hides.

items.sl: Morda zato, ker je zmaj močan in pogumen. Tak bi rad bil vsak.
items.en: Maybe because a dragon is strong and brave. Everyone would like to be like that.

items.sl: Lisica! Ima rep z belo konico.
items.en: A fox! It has a tail with a white tip.

items.sl: Brdavs se smeje: »Ti in tvoja mala kobila?«
items.en: Brdavs laughs: 'You and your little mare?'

items.sl: Zdaj ste starejši, ampak še vedno močni.
items.en: Now you're older, but still strong.

items.sl: Hvala! Deset jajc za tri evre.
items.en: Thank you! Ten eggs for three euros.
